node.statement: Fix the universal constants P >= 1 and q in (0,1/2] supplied by lem-stage1-polar-retraction, and set C_grp=600, C_pol=P, and kappa_pol=min(q,1/64). Then C_pol*(epsilon_r+delta)<=kappa_pol implies epsilon_r,delta<=1/64 and supplies the C^1 polar diffeomorphism and inner inclusion calU_t subseteq S_delta with t=delta-C_pol*(epsilon_r*delta+delta^2). By lem-stage1-polar-coherence-naturality, this inverse u_delta agrees on overlaps with every other admissible polar inverse, so the restricted choice is coherent.
